cards.name: Tangela
cards.description: It tangles any moving thing with its vines. Their subtle shaking is ticklish if you get ensnared.

cards.name: Nuzleaf
cards.description: It lives deep in forests. With the leaf on its head, it makes a flute whose song makes listeners uneasy.

cards.name: Shiftry
cards.description: By flapping its leafy fan, it can whip up gusts of 100 ft/second that can level houses.

cards.name: Foongus
cards.description: It lures Pokémon with its pattern that looks just like a Poké Ball then releases poison spores.

cards.name: Amoonguss
cards.description: It lures prey close by dancing and waving its arm caps, which resemble Poké Balls, in a swaying motion.

cards.name: Larvesta
cards.description: The base of volcanoes is where they make their homes. They shoot fire from their five horns to repel attacking enemies.

cards.name: Volcarona
cards.description: When volcanic ash darkened the atmosphere, it is said that Volcarona's fire provided a replacement for the sun.

cards.name: Ponyta
cards.description: Its legs grow strong while it chases after its parent. It runs in fields and mountains all day.

cards.name: Rapidash
cards.description: It gallops at nearly 150 mph. With its mane blazing ferociously, it races as if it were an arrow.

cards.name: Chimchar
cards.description: The gas made in its belly burns from its rear end. The fire burns weakly when it feels sick.

cards.name: Monferno
cards.description: It uses ceilings and walls to launch aerial attacks. Its fiery tail is but one weapon.

cards.name: Tangrowth
cards.description: Its vines grow so profusely that, in the warm season, you can't even see its eyes.

cards.name: Infernape
cards.description: It tosses its enemies around with agility. It uses all its limbs to fight in its own unique style.

cards.name: Litleo
cards.description: They set off on their own from their pride and live by themselves to become stronger. These hot-blooded Pokémon are quick to fight.

cards.name: Pyroar
cards.description: With fiery breath of more than 10,000 degrees Fahrenheit, they viciously threaten any challenger. The females protect the pride's cubs.

cards.name: Volcanion
cards.description: It expels its internal steam from the arms on its back. It has enough power to blow away a mountain.

cards.name: Mantine
cards.description: While elegantly swimming in the sea, it ignores Remoraid that cling to its fins seeking food scraps.

cards.name: Shellos
cards.description: Its shape and coloration vary, depending on its habitat.

cards.name: Gastrodon
cards.description: It apparently had a huge shell for protection in ancient times. It lives in shallow tidal pools.

cards.name: Hoppip
cards.description: It drifts on winds. It is said that when Hoppip gather in fields and mountains, spring is on the way.

cards.name: Oshawott
cards.description: It fights using the scalchop on its stomach. In response to an attack, it retaliates immediately by slashing.

cards.name: Dewott
cards.description: As a result of strict training, each Dewott learns different forms for using the scalchops.

cards.name: Samurott
cards.description: One swing of the sword incorporated in its armor can fell an opponent. A simple glare from one of them quiets everybody.

cards.name: Clauncher
cards.description: Through controlled expulsions of internal gas, it can expel water like a pistol shot. At close distances, it can shatter rock.

cards.name: Clawitzer
cards.description: By expelling water from the nozzle in the back of its claw, it can move at a speed of 60 knots.

cards.name: Bergmite
cards.description: Using air of -150 degrees Fahrenheit, they freeze opponents solid. They live in herds above the snow line on mountains.

cards.name: Avalugg
cards.description: The way several Bergmite huddle on its back make it look like an aircraft carrier made of ice.

cards.name: Mareep
cards.description: It stores lots of air in its soft fur, allowing it to stay cool in summer and warm in winter.

cards.name: Flaaffy
cards.description: If its coat becomes fully charged with electricity, its tail lights up. It fires hair that zaps on impact.

cards.name: Skiploom
cards.description: It spreads its petals to absorb sunlight. It also floats in the air to get closer to the sun.

cards.name: Ampharos
cards.description: The tail's tip shines brightly and can be seen from far away. It acts as a beacon for lost people.

cards.name: Joltik
cards.description: They attach themselves to large-bodied Pokémon and absorb static electricity, which they store in an electric pouch.

cards.name: Galvantula
cards.description: When attacked, they create an electric barrier by spitting out many electrically charged threads.

cards.name: Nidoran♂
cards.description: Its large ears are flapped like wings when it is listening to distant sounds. It extends toxic barbs when angered.

cards.name: Nidorino
cards.description: An aggressive Pokémon that is quick to attack. The horn on its head secretes a powerful venom.

cards.name: Nidoking
cards.description: One swing of its mighty tail can snap a telephone pole as if it were a matchstick.

cards.name: Drifloon
cards.description: These Pokémon are called the "Signpost for Wandering Spirits." Children holding them sometimes vanish.

cards.name: Drifblim
cards.description: It's drowsy in daytime, but flies off in the evening in big groups. No one knows where they go.

cards.name: Litwick
cards.description: Litwick shines a light that absorbs the life energy of people and Pokémon, which becomes the fuel that it burns.

cards.name: Lampent
cards.description: It arrives near the moment of death and steals spirit from the body.

cards.name: Jumpluff
cards.description: Even in the fiercest wind, it can control its fluff to make its way to any place in the world it wants.

cards.name: Chandelure
cards.description: The spirits burned up in its ominous flame lose their way and wander this world forever.

cards.name: Hoopa
cards.description: It is said to be able to seize anything it desires with its six rings and six huge arms. With its power sealed, it is transformed into a much smaller form.

cards.name: Mankey
cards.description: It lives in treetop colonies. If one becomes enraged, the whole colony rampages for no reason.

cards.name: Primeape
cards.description: It is always outrageously furious. If it gives chase, it will tenaciously track the target no matter how far.

cards.name: Nosepass
cards.description: Its magnetic nose consistently faces north. Travelers check Nosepass to get their bearings.

cards.name: Probopass
cards.description: It freely controls three small units called Mini-Noses using magnetic force.

cards.name: Anorith
cards.description: A Pokémon ancestor that was reanimated from a fossil. It lived in the sea and hunted with claws.

cards.name: Armaldo
cards.description: Protected by a hard shell, its body is very sturdy. It skewers prey with its claws to feed.

cards.name: Croagunk
cards.description: Inflating its poison sacs, it fills the area with an odd sound and hits flinching opponents with a poison jab.

cards.name: Toxicroak
cards.description: Its knuckle claws secrete a toxin so vile that even a scratch could prove fatal.

cards.name: Yanma
cards.description: If it flaps its wings really fast, it can generate shock waves that will shatter windows in the area.

cards.name: Sneasel
cards.description: Its paws conceal sharp claws. If attacked, it suddenly extends the claws and startles its enemy.

cards.name: Weavile
cards.description: They live in cold regions, forming groups of four or five that hunt prey with impressive coordination.

cards.name: Spiritomb
cards.description: It was bound to a fissure in an Odd Keystone as punishment for misdeeds 500 years ago.

cards.name: Pawniard
cards.description: Ignoring their injuries, groups attack by sinking the blades that cover their bodies into their prey.

cards.name: Bisharp
cards.description: Bisharp pursues prey in the company of a large group of Pawniard. Then Bisharp finishes off the prey.

cards.name: Yveltal
cards.description: When its life comes to an end, it absorbs the life energy of every living thing and turns into a cocoon once more.

cards.name: Shieldon
cards.description: It was generated from a fossil dug out of a layer of clay that was older than anyone knows. It has a sturdy face.

cards.name: Yanmega
cards.description: This six-legged Pokémon is easily capable of transporting an adult in flight. The wings on its tail help it stay balanced.

cards.name: Bastiodon
cards.description: Any frontal attack is repulsed. It is a docile Pokémon that feeds on grass and berries.

cards.name: Klink
cards.description: The two minigears that mesh together are predetermined. Each will rebound from other minigears without meshing.

cards.name: Klang
cards.description: A minigear and big gear comprise its body. If the minigear it launches at a foe doesn't return, it will die.

cards.name: Klinklang
cards.description: Its red core functions as an energy tank. It fires the charged energy through its spikes into an area.

cards.name: Cobalion
cards.description: It has a body and heart of steel. It worked with its allies to punish people when they hurt Pokémon.

cards.name: Marill
cards.description: The tip of its tail is filled with oil that is lighter than water, so it acts as a float.

cards.name: Azumarill
cards.description: The bubble-like pattern on its stomach helps it camouflage itself when it's in the water.

cards.name: Klefki
cards.description: It never lets go of a key that it likes, so people give it the keys to vaults and safes as a way to prevent crime.

cards.name: Xerneas
cards.description: Legends say it can share eternal life. It slept for a thousand years in the form of a tree before its revival.

cards.name: Druddigon
cards.description: It warms its body by absorbing sunlight with its wings. When its body temperature falls, it can no longer move.

cards.name: Deino
cards.description: Lacking sight, it's unaware of its surroundings, so it bumps into things and eats anything that moves.

cards.name: Zweilous
cards.description: After it has eaten up all the food in its territory, it moves to another area. Its two heads do not get along.

cards.name: Hydreigon
cards.description: It responds to movement by attacking. This scary, three-headed Pokémon devours everything in its path!

cards.name: Meowth
cards.description: Adores round objects. It wanders the streets on a nightly basis to look for dropped loose change.

cards.name: Persian
cards.description: Its lithe muscles allow it to walk without making a sound. It attacks in an instant.

cards.name: Seedot
cards.description: When it dangles from a tree branch, it looks just like an acorn. It enjoys scaring other Pokémon.

cards.name: Aipom
cards.description: Its tail is so powerful that it can use it to grab a tree branch and hold itself up in the air.

cards.name: Ambipom
cards.description: To eat, it deftly shucks nuts with its two tails. It rarely uses its arms now.

cards.name: Rufflet
cards.description: They will challenge anything, even strong opponents, without fear. Their frequent fights help them become stronger.

cards.name: Braviary
cards.description: They fight for their friends without any thought about danger to themselves. One can carry a car while flying.

cards.name: Fletchling
cards.description: Despite the beauty of its lilting voice, it's merciless to intruders that enter its territory.

cards.name: Fletchinder
cards.description: The hotter the flame sac on its belly, the faster it can fly, but it takes some time to get the fire going.

cards.name: Talonflame
cards.description: When attacking prey, it can reach speeds of up to 310 mph. It finishes its prey off with a colossal kick.

cards.name: Hawlucha
cards.description: With its wings, it controls its position in the air. It likes to attack from above, a maneuver that is difficult to defend against.
